answer: Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. Each submission hangs on the tundra of a task receipt, and the onyx is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the meadow of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, forfeited on duplicate submission.
